name: kitsu
description: Coordinate coding tasks from an idea, an existing design or an unfinished patch. Kitsu records the requested outcome, specialist handoffs, review findings, executed checks and delivery status.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate coding agents with roles, task records and token reports
interface.longDescription: The task skill guides Codex through the remaining work and lets a developer resume from the saved task record. Choose a stopping point for planning, review, verification or delivery. The managed workflow provides seven specialist roles. Token reports show available usage evidence. An optional Git gate checks evidence before commits and pushes.
defaultPrompt: Use the task skill to plan and implement a change with specialist coding agents
Show the coding-agent roles and explain the next stage of this task
